capacity_basis: the advertised limit is the phrase 'Limited API calls' with no number; no public statement says which operations consume the quota — extraction, matching, model loading, or every API call
questions_a_licence_must_answer: does every API call consume quota?
workload_budget_basis: The workload is frozen and the metering is not. Under the most expensive published reading the run costs at most 9200 metered operations, which is the figure a licence would have to cover before a single comparison is run. No reading of the public terms establishes whether an evaluation licence covers it.
notes: The workload was frozen before the capacity was asked about, and not after. A run that is trimmed to fit a quota is a different protocol reported under the same name (docs/adr/0096).
'We will try it and see' is refused explicitly. A quota exhausted at comparison four thousand leaves two thousand comparisons that were never run and a result that cannot be published.
